facts.business: Balmer Lawrie Investments Limited is an investment holding company whose primary business is holding equity shares of Balmer Lawrie & Company Limited and receiving dividend income from it.

auditor.name: K.K. Chanani & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Non-compliance with Regulation 17 of Listing Regulations and Para 3.1.1 and 3.1.4 of DPE Guidelines: Board strength below minimum of six directors, no Woman Director or Independent Director appointed, and no optimum combination of Functional, Nominee and Independent Directors. Non-compliance with Regulation 17(2A) regarding quorum for Board Meetings. Non-compliance with Regulations 18, 19, 20 regarding composition, chairmanship, and quorum of Audit Committee, Nomination & Remuneration Committee, and Stakeholders' Relationship Committee due to absence of Independent Directors.

key_risks: Non-compliance with corporate governance requirements due to insufficient Board composition (below minimum directors, no Woman/Independent Directors)
Non-compliance with Board meeting quorum requirements
Non-compliance with Committee composition requirements (Audit, NRC, Stakeholders Relationship)
Absence of Chief Financial Officer as required under Section 203(1)(iii)
Subsidiary VPLPL's TCW business segment non-operational due to financial constraints
VPLPL's dependence on Strategic Alliance Management Operator (SAMO) contract for loan servicing and profitability
facts.related_party_note: The Company has two subsidiaries: Balmer Lawrie & Company Limited (61.80% shareholding) and Visakhapatnam Port Logistics Park Limited (held through BL). Major income is dividend received from subsidiary Balmer Lawrie & Company Limited. VPLPL is a 60:40 joint venture between BL and Visakhapatnam Port Authority.
